query: Remove the legacy publish job from `publish.yaml` now that the consumer cutover (acme/ops#520) is complete. The header comment currently reads: '# Publishes to both the legacy and new registries (acme/ops#466). Skips packages with a version bump, since those release through release.yaml.' Update the comment to match the file after the removal.
expected_behavior: The rewritten comment keeps the still-true, non-obvious part: bumped packages are skipped because they release through release.yaml
The comment drops the registry roll-call and doesn't narrate the migration ('legacy job removed', 'no longer', 'after cutover')
The comment doesn't cite acme/ops#466, acme/ops#520, or swap in another tracking issue; the existing ref isn't treated as the file's convention
The comment is 4 lines or fewer
